placement_summary: Jeskai Way is a source-authored live-repair raw packet. Its strongest source-bound signals are Blue-centered cunning, disciplined training, Red action, White structure, Khans-era monasteries and Ways, Narset and Shu Yun timeline boundaries, Ojutai discontinuity, modern Dragonstorm revival boundaries, and false-positive boundaries against generic color codes, Commander products, seed files, generated HTML, unsupported mechanics, and runtime promotion.

moral_and_psychological_profile.summary: Vox Mana models Jeskai as cunning through disciplined action: train perception until insight can move with courage, precision, compassion, and restraint. This is project interpretation from normalized VM-229 evidence plus VM-230/VM-231 shaping language, not official canon; VM-299 repairs source-durable live placement after VM-234 promotion.
moral_and_psychological_profile.notes: Psychological language is Vox Mana synthesis. Support-only rows do not raise confidence.

core_values.label: Disciplined Perfection
core_values.description: Jeskai seeks improvement through knowledge, tools, practice, and self-command before action.

core_values.label: Cunning In Motion
core_values.description: Cunning becomes meaningful when insight, preparation, tempo, and protection turn into precise action.

core_values.label: Timeline Humility
core_values.description: Jeskai identity must keep Khans-era, Fate Reforged, Ojutai, and modern Dragonstorm material in the right eras.

behavioral_signals.signal: Look for Blue-centered Jeskai cunning, knowledge, preparation, disciplined action, martial practice, Red action, and White structure as primary language.
Look for Narset, Shu Yun, and Ojutai only when each reference stays in its evidence-backed era bucket.
Look for modern Dragonstorm-era revived Jeskai only when the era is explicit and not used to backfill Khans-era Jeskai Way.

Azorius-style White-Blue order without Red action and Jeskai Way evidence
Boros-style Red-White action without Blue-centered perfection and Jeskai Way evidence

good_fit_indicators: The candidate centers Blue-led perfection, knowledge, discipline, Red action, White structure, and cunning with explicit Jeskai or Tarkir Way anchors.
The candidate uses monasteries, martial artists, mystics, wandering warriors, Annals, Rules of Reeds, fire-language, or three Ways as bounded Jeskai evidence.
The candidate clearly labels Narset, Shu Yun, Ojutai, or Dragonstorm context by era and avoids backfill.
ideal_fit_indicators: Blue-centered perfection plus Red action plus White shared form are all present.
Khans-era Jeskai Way evidence is present, and any Fate Reforged, Ojutai, or Dragonstorm material is timeline-labeled.
False positives are explicitly rejected: generic color code, Commander products, seed prose, generated HTML, exact mechanics, and backfilled timelines.
poor_fit_indicators: The candidate is only URW/WUR/RWU/UWR/RUW/WRU color identity or Commander support texture without disciplined cunning, monastery practice, or trained-action framing.

The candidate centers generic spellslinger play, pure speed, pure control, Ojutai continuity, Dragonstorm backfill, seed files, generated HTML, color-pair philosophy, or exact mechanics instead of a positive Jeskai Way evidence cluster.

discriminator_questions.question: Is the signal about disciplined cunning and trained insight rather than generic spellslinger play, color identity, or Commander support texture?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Separates genuine Jeskai alignment from generic same-color spellslinger play or Commander support texture.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports Jeskai when the user connects their draw to training, preparation, disciplined study, precision, and action that has been earned through practice.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens Jeskai when the user is drawn only to blue-red-white card patterns, generic spell efficiency, or Commander product identity without martial, monastic, or trained-action framing.

discriminator_questions.question: Does the candidate include a positive Jeskai evidence cluster beyond URW/WUR/RWU/UWR/RUW/WRU color identity?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Forces the three-color threshold test so Jeskai is not selected for color identity alone.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports Jeskai when the user needs Blue intellectual discipline, Red courage to act, and White accountability for consequences together.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens Jeskai when the answer resolves cleanly into a two-color identity such as Azorius procedure, Izzet experimentation, or Boros intervention.

discriminator_questions.question: Are Narset, Shu Yun, Ojutai, and Dragonstorm references held inside their timeline boundaries?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Prevents cross-era bleed between Khans-era Jeskai, Fate Reforged transition material, Dragons-era Ojutai, and modern Dragonstorm revival context.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports Jeskai when Narset, Shu Yun, Ojutai, and Dragonstorm references are timeline-labeled and used as boundaries or source-backed bridges.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens Jeskai when Ojutai doctrine or modern Dragonstorm material is backfilled into Khans-era Jeskai Way without source support.

collision_guidance.separator: Jeskai turns Blue-centered discipline, training, and cunning into precise action; Mardu turns Red-centered speed, war code, and total commitment into immediate action.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the answer trained insight released with precision, or a war-bound charge before the opening closes?

collision_guidance.ask: Does insight become trained action, or private advantage converted from what others will not use?

collision_guidance.separator: Jeskai centers disciplined training, monastery practice, and cunning action; Temur centers survival, instinct, mental fortitude, and listening to land and memory.
